column1: # The data build of the metagaming-filtered 30B SFT, one line per corpus, consumed by
# verify_corpora.py against the same line. Columns, in order (semantics in corpora_table.py):
#   subset | stage | kind | config | prep_h | tok_h | workers | shards | shard_mode | stripe | docs
# The row is the unfiltered baseline's (../../control_pretraining/30b_baseline_ablations/
# corpora.tsv) with only the subset, the prepare config and the document count changed, so the two
# packs are built by the same chain at the same geometry: a byte-gated split into 32 shards, each
# packed in its own job. The shard count is a host-memory budget for the pack job (~47.8k packs per
# shard at ~50B tokens, the baseline's measured size; 16 shards OOM-killed at 449 GB), and this
# corpus is the same token budget.
# docs is the `train` split's row count at the pinned revision, from the dataset-builder's push
# notice; the verifier checks the prepared JSONL against it.
